full_judgment:
Md. Abdur Rouf J: This petition for leave by the defendant is from the judgment and decree dated 26-5-93 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in FA No. 63 of 1988 dismissing the appeal and affirming with modification the judgment and decree passed on 28-4-88 by the Subordinate judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka, decreeing Title Suit No. 217 of 1985, a suit for specific performance of contract for sale of immoveable property. 

 4. On consideration of 3 PWs and 2 DWs the trial Court decreed the suit on 284-88. The defendants' appeal was dismissed with the modification that the plaintiffs were directed to pay a further sum of Taka 32,000.00 to defendant ,No. 1 in addition to Taka 1,33,000.00 the balance consideration money under the Agreement which the plaintiffs had already deposited in court. 

 6. No doubt the decree for specific performance of contract is a discretionary relief and the court is not bound to grant such relief merely because it is lawful to do so, but such discretion should be exercised upon sound and reasonable judicial principles. The defendant could not bring her case within any of the exceptions provided under section 22 of the Specific Relief Act. Defendant No.1, did not take the course of making out a case of hardship in her written statement. Rather, she took the hard line that the plaintiffs having failed to perform their part of the agreement it lost its legal force. She is not permitted to raise a special case of hardship for the first time before this Division. The case has been concluded by concurrent finding of facts. No point of law of public importance is involved in this case.
